{"consolidated_memory":"ui/state/cacheSlice.ts: Stale state in cache slice (TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS)

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-24]:
- File/Component: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web ui side)
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Problem: stale state in the cache slice
- Signal: old value still in the store snapshot
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #1872, branch fix/stale-state-1)
- Reproduction: edit a record then navigate back to the list
- Stack: TypeScript
- Test: ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts
- Result: flaky test went from 10 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-05]:
- File/Component: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web ui side)
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Problem: stale state in the cache slice
- Signal: old value still in the store snapshot
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #8001, branch fix/stale-state-2)
- Reproduction: edit a record then navigate back to the list
- Stack: TypeScript
- Test: ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 9 consecutive days"}
